pointSource.pac1.task: Sign-up: Each chief signs up in the Alliance Championship sign-up area, picks a lane and places troops. These troops do not use march slots and are not killed. Every member who signs up can get rewards, even without battling.
pointSource.pac2.task: Matchmaking: The game puts 6 alliances of the same or a similar tier in one group. A signed-up alliance cannot disband until the Championship ends. A member who quits during Matchmaking still fights but gets no rewards.
pointSource.pac3.task: Rounds: Each alliance meets the other 5 of its group, one round each. Before each round's battle, the Leader and R4s can move troops between the 3 lanes or swap single armies in a lane.
pointSource.pac4.task: Battle: In each lane, the troops with the highest Power fight first and each army fights at most twice. The first alliance to defeat all enemy troops in a lane takes its flag. Only expedition hero skills work.
pointSource.pac5.task: Points: The alliance with more flags wins the round and gets 3 points, and a draw gives both 1 point. Alliances are ranked in their group by Championship Points, and ties are decided by the flags captured and the enemies defeated.
pointSource.pacw1.task: Rewards are sent by mail when round 5 ends, on Friday at 12:00 UTC, only to the members in the alliance at that time.
pointSource.pacw2.task: Prestige Rewards are granted after battling in the Ultimate tier.
pointSource.pacw3.task: KO Rewards are given to the combatants after each round. Defeating 1 enemy team gives KO Reward 1, and defeating 2 teams or staying undefeated gives KO Reward 2. Only the chiefs on the combatant list, the 20 most powerful, can get them, and lane changes can leave some chiefs off it.
pointSource.pcj1.task: Start: R4s and the Leader start the event and set its start time. The difficulty is chosen in Settings.
pointSource.pcj2.task: Defense: A defense succeeds when 50% or more of the enemy troops are killed. Bandits attacking the Alliance HQ go to the Tundra HQ first, or to the Icefield HQ if there is none.
pointSource.pcj3.task: More points: Elite Bandits at Lv. 7, 14 and 17 and Crazy Joe at Lv. 10 and 20 give many points. The Elite Bandits attack only online chiefs, and Crazy Joe at Lv. 10 and 20 attacks the Alliance HQ. Reinforcing allies earns points equal to 50% of the defeats, without lowering theirs.
pointSource.pcj4.task: Leaving the alliance: It clears the chief's points with that alliance, but not their personal ranking or rewards.
pointSource.pcjw1.task: Rewards are sent by mail within 12 hours after the event. Alliance Ranking Rewards go only to members in the alliance at that time.
pointSource.pdb2.task: Call a rally and hunt down 1 Polar Terror
pointSource.pdbr1.task: Targets: A higher Furnace level at the start of the event means higher point targets and better rewards.
pointSource.pdbw1.task: The top 100 chiefs with over 20 points get these by mail.
pointSource.pds1.task: Dream Fishbits: Each chief gets 20 Dream Fishbits at the start, and each chapter costs Fishbits to start. A failed chapter returns 10 Fishbits for Chapter 1, 16 for Chapter 2, 18 for Chapter 3, 16 for Chapter 4 and 10 for Chapter 5, and none for Chapters 6 to 10. Fishbits left at the end of the event are removed.
pointSource.pds2.task: Chapters: Chapters are played in order, and so are the stages of each chapter. Each stage has a time limit to find all its items. Failing a stage fails the chapter, resets its progress and removes the prizes gathered in it.
pointSource.pds3.task: Hints and Extra Time: Some stages give free Hints for that stage. After a failed stage, Dreambells add Extra Time with a free Hint, and each further Hint costs more Dreambells.
pointSource.pds4.task: Express Mode: It unlocks once the state has completed 5 Dreamscape Memory seasons and the chief has reached Lv. 10 in the event. Turned on before a chapter starts, it clears all the chapter's stages at once for Fishbits and Dreambells. Once it is unlocked, Fishbits can be exchanged for Dreambells, up to a limit each season.
pointSource.pdsw1.task: Chapter rewards are claimed automatically when the chapter is completed. Recall XP raises the Recall Road level. Dream Nest Lv. 1 is a Mythic 3x3 decoration with Troops' Defense +1.0%, stored in the Island Storehouse.
pointSource.pff1.task: Registration: Chiefs pick a battle time and can change it until registration ends. A chief who misses a battle can register for a later one up to 10 minutes before it starts. No troops may be out of the city when entering the battlefield.
pointSource.pff2.task: Battle: Each battle lasts 30 minutes. Troops are unlimited, at the chief's highest trainable level, and none are killed. Lv. 1 to 3 Veins are guarded by Phaethon Mine Guards, and once they are defeated a squad can hold the Vein to gather Orichalcum. Vein Outbursts appear at times and gather faster. Chiefs can attack Veins held by other chiefs, allies included, but not their cities. Heroes of a defeated squad cannot fight for 5 minutes.
pointSource.pff3.task: Smelter: The Smelter opens late in each battle. Chiefs who hold it are ranked by how long they held it and get Orichalcum for it at the end.
pointSource.pff4.task: Teleport: Advanced Teleporters are free in the mine, with a cooldown, and extra ones can be used during the cooldown.
pointSource.pff5.task: Bonuses: Tech Research, VIP, item and skin bonuses work in the mine. March Speed and Hunting March Speed bonuses do not, except those from Frostfire Skills.
pointSource.pffw1.task: Gathering and ranking rewards are given at the end of the event, by the total Orichalcum gathered.
pointSource.pffw2.task: Chiefs who held the Smelter for more than 1 second are ranked by how long they held it.
pointSource.pflw1.task: Completing Lighthouse Intel gives Crystallite Cores, which are exchanged here.

pointSource.psr1.task:
Winning:
Personal Points also count as Alliance Points for the chief's alliance.
Each day, the alliance with more Alliance Points wins the day and earns Victory Points.
The alliance with the most Victory Points at the end wins the event.
pointSource.psr2.task: Daily Chests: Personal Points from each day's objectives unlock the Daily Chests.
pointSource.psr3.task:
Baldur:
Dawn Hymn raises Alliance Showdown points by 5% per level, up to 50% at level 10, except for the Tundra Trade Route.
Dawn Hymn adds 1 extra Daily Chest tier, 2 from level 6 and 3 at level 10.
pointSource.psr4.task: MVP: Each day, the top-scoring chief of the winning alliance is the Daily MVP, or of both alliances if the day is tied. The top contributor of the winning side over the season is the Seasonal MVP. If chiefs tie on score, the one who reached it first is MVP.
pointSource.psr5.task: Changing alliance: If a chief leaves the alliance, their Personal Points are kept and they can keep earning them for Daily Chests in another qualified alliance. Points for their original alliance and for the ranking only count again once they return to it.
pointSource.psr6.task:
Rewards:
Alliance members are ranked by their total Personal Points, and a higher rank gives bigger Ranking rewards. Alliance Daily, Star and Ranking rewards go to the chiefs who are in the alliance when they are tallied. Ranking rewards are sent on Sunday at 12:00 UTC.
Requirements for ranking rewards
Alliance: 20,000,000 points
Player: over 300,000 Personal Points
pointSource.pthm1.task: Treasure Hunt Points unlock rewards in the Treasure Hunt Drill, and Gems of Enigma open chests in Frosty Fortune. Daily Missions refresh at 00:00 UTC.
pointSource.ptl1.task: Sent to the legion's combatants and substitutes at 24:00 UTC on every match day, after the league rankings are calculated.
pointSource.ptl2.task: Sent to all members of the legion's alliance at 24:00 UTC on every match day, after the league rankings are calculated.
pointSource.ptl3.task: Chiefs at Furnace 20 or higher in the states of the top 4 legions claim them once the Hall of Heroism begins.
pointSource.ptm1.task: Match Missions run from the first Monday until the event ends. Daily missions refresh at 00:00 UTC, and weekly missions at 00:00 UTC on Mondays.
pointSource.ptp1.task: Match Prediction: Match Prediction opens at 00:00 UTC on the day before each battle and closes when the battle starts. Players can predict up to 3 matches each round. A right prediction pays back double and a wrong one returns half, by mail after the match.
pointSource.ptp2.task: Champion Prediction: Champion Prediction opens on Elimination round 3 and takes stakes only on the days without battles. Players can put up to 800 Champion Stakes on a legion of their zone each round, at ×16, ×8, ×4, ×3 and ×2 for the 5 rounds in order. If the legion is knocked out, half the stakes come back then and the rest after the final.
pointSource.ptp3.task: Prediction Shop: Match Stakes are spent in the Ordinary Shop and Champion Stakes in the Champion Shop, both open until the event ends.
pointSource.ptr1.task:
Sign-up:
Voting for battle times runs Monday and Tuesday. Registration runs Wednesday to Friday, until 24:00 UTC, when the lists and battle times lock.
Each legion registers up to 30 combatants, 20 substitutes and 3 battle times from 02:00, 07:00, 12:00, 14:00 and 19:00 UTC. The game sets each match's time from both legions' picks.
Members send a Battle Request to one legion and can switch until registration ends. Legions are ranked by the Troop Power of their top 20 registered chiefs.
pointSource.ptr2.task: Elimination: The loser of each match is out, and the winner of each group of 16 reaches the Championship. The 2 with the most Net Wins Points (Alliance Arsenal Points minus the opponent's, over all Elimination matches) start in the Gold group and the other 2 in Silver. A legion without an opponent gets the zone's best Net Wins Points for that round.
pointSource.ptr3.task: Championship: A Gold winner stays in Gold and a Gold loser drops to Silver. A Silver winner moves up to Gold and a Silver loser is out. The top Gold and Silver legions play the final.
pointSource.ptr4.task: Foundry Battle: Combatants and substitutes cannot play Foundry Battle while their legion is in the tournament, except those knocked out in Elimination round 1. Results do not change the Foundry Battle Tier.
pointSource.ptr5.task: Pets: Battle-type pet skills are ready at 00:00 UTC on each battle day and again at 00:00 UTC the next day.
pointSource.ptr6.task: Watching: Chiefs of participating states can watch every match in every zone.
pointSource.ptw3.task: Championship Advancement Rewards: Every member of the legion's alliance gets them right after all Elimination round 4 battles, if the legion advances. Members who left the alliance before then get none.
pointSource.pvod15.task: 50 coins: 100 Enhancement XP Component ×5, Chief Stamina ×5
pointSource.pvod17.task: 110 coins: War Chant Custom Chest ×3, Chief Stamina ×20
pointSource.pvod4.task: Call a rally and hunt down 3 Polar Terrors
pointSource.pvod5.task: Call a rally and hunt down 10 Polar Terrors
pointSource.pwb1.task: Icebreaker Shop: Pioneer Badges are spent here and can be used only during Wild Brawl.
pointSource.pws1.task:
Winning:
The first alliance to take all of the enemy's Stars wins.
If neither does, the one with more Stars left wins.
If Stars are tied, the one with more Troop Power left in its strongholds wins.
If Troop Power is also tied, the alliance that lost its last Star later wins.
If both alliances start the Battle with the same number of Stars and end it with the same number, both lose.
pointSource.pws2.task: Morale: Every defence a garrison squad wins lowers its Morale, and its stats with it, down to 60%. Losing a Heart restores it to 100%.
pointSource.pws3.task:
Bonuses:
Disabled: Hero Exclusive Gear Skills, Territory bonuses, State Positions, President Skills, City bonuses, and Frostdragon Tyrant Titles
Enabled: Pet skills - active by default.
pointSource.pws4.task: Changing alliance: If a chief leaves the alliance during Preparation, their squads are removed from the strongholds. If they leave after Preparation, their squads stay in the strongholds and keep defending. In both cases, the chief can't take part in the event until they return to their original alliance.
pointSource.pws5.task: Rewards: Rewards depend on the alliance's tier at the start of the event. They are handed out when the Battle ends, to everyone who is in the alliance at that moment. Winning two events in a row gives Win Streak rewards instead of Victory rewards. An alliance that gets no opponent at Matchmaking receives the Victory rewards straight away.
pointSource.pwt1.task: Wanderer Missions: the same 4 every day, refreshed at reset. They give Talismans of Ice, used for Protected Exploration in the Wander Theater.
pointSource.pwt2.task: Call a rally and hunt down 1 Polar Terror
pointSource.pwt6.task: Bizarre Bazaar (open 1 day after the missions end), prices in Wonderstar Coins. Coins left when the event ends turn into 1 Gem each.
pointSource.pwt7.task: Chief Gear Materials Chest ×1 (5 a day)
